title: Certify selected k8 label instances in Lean
body:
## Summary

```text
pinned k8 programs
  translate all 49,514 non-phase events
  kernel-check 97 blocks per orientation
  derive WellLabelled and final labels for both complete words
```

Add `research/k8-lean-label-instance/`, following Sagar Thakrar's [PR1964](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1964) Python H1 audit and the [PR1611](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1611)/[PR2748](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2748) event bindings. The new concrete Lean certificates include private COPY/CLEAR and all wrapper tags. Existing event semantics are reused.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR1964's complete extended-label instance was checked in Python; a concrete `WellLabelled` instance remained an open handoff.
- **After:** four Lean roots prove `Stream.WellLabelled` and final `labRun` labels for the translated forward/backward words. Fresh kernel reduction uses only the three retained axioms, with no `native_decide`; a false relabel theorem is rejected.
- Both 24,767-event emissions match the selected hashes. Ten actual-program semantic controls and ten focused tests pass, as do metadata/source checks, repository onboarding tests and Ruff. The saved formal receipt binds every input and generated module.
- The committed-byte preflight passes for all 27 package/input files, and a read-only Git export without Git passes the receipt replay and ten tests. The registered-package planner selects only this new package.
- Two read-only internal reviews checked translation and formal/generator completeness. The receipt snapshot issue they identified is fixed and covered by a regression test. Substantial AI assistance is disclosed in the package; no independent human review is claimed.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/k8-lean-label-instance

# With the existing Lean 4.21.0 / Mathlib v4.21.0 environment prepared:
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B \
  research/k8-lean-label-instance/check_lean.py --lake-project formal/lean
```

Started from current main `9ee73fecdbae9f892a6496dbdfae872217cf4601`, priority revision 5. The submission refresh at `95ff4e2dd396c505932a43ff7c1cdfdd94b8c867` has unchanged guidance and consumed inputs. The package records the live overlap coverage. The canonical [investigation and claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2703#discussioncomment-18974164) retains predecessor credit and the remaining handoff.

This proves H1 for the translated fixed words. The Python/JSON adapter, exact operator recipes, scalar endpoints, hosting, all-size, precision/tape and supplier admission remain outside scope. No new kappa or complete selected cold replay is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** package.

Only a new opt-in package is added. The default CI replay checks the source/generated-proof binding and Python controls; fresh Lean compilation is an explicit separate command. The selected frontier and frozen predecessors are unchanged.
